data.title: BlackRock's US Equity ETF Head Says Bitcoin's Diversifier Role 'Still Very Much Holds' As AI's Best Bets Move 'Outside Of Tech'
data.description: Wall Street may have changed who owns Bitcoin, but it hasn’t changed why investors own it, according to BlackRock's (BLK) U.S. Head of Equity ETFs, Jay Jacobs.Bitcoin's (BTC) role as a portfolio diversifier survived its institutional takeover, and Jacobs said the best opportunities in AI now sit ou…
